# `silk/platform/wasm/start`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The program entry for the standalone LLVM-to-WebAssembly profile.

## When to use
Select this module as the runtime root for a wasm32 program with no host services. The host
calls the exported `main` function with no arguments and gets an `i32` exit status.

## Details
`main` in the application can return one of these types:

| `main` returns | Exit status |
|---|---|
| `i32` | The value |
| `()` | `0` |
| `Effect<() ! E>` | `0` on success, `1` on a failure (the payload is dropped first) |

The application runs inside its own `Execution`. Nested transfers complete before the exported
`main` returns. If the application is still parked at the end, or the `Execution` cannot be
allocated, the status is `1`.

With the `threading` profile set to `multi`, the module also exports the entry that runs each
thread `NativeThread.spawn` starts.

## Gotchas
- The host gives no arguments and no services. The application source supplies each service
  requirement.
- The complete application call must satisfy `Intrinsic.NonParking`. To park on an external
  event, the application must own that wait itself.
- There is no diagnostic observer. A fatal trap stays a bare machine trap, with no cleanup.
